arguments.body: Settled naming conventions: Services are named with singular nouns and no environment in the name. Queues end in `-events` or `-commands` depending on direction. Scheduled jobs carry their cadence as a suffix. Anything shared across teams gets the team prefix. Treat this as the final reference.
